shortDescription: Updates the network configuration on OpenManage Enterprise

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: enable_nic
options.description: Enable or disable Network Interface Card (NIC) configuration.

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: interface_name
options.description: If there are multiple interfaces, network configuration changes can be applied to a single interface using the interface name of the NIC. If this option is not specified, Primary interface is chosen by default.

options.name: ipv4_configuration
options.description: IPv4 network configuration. I(Warning) Ensure that you have an alternate interface to access OpenManage Enterprise as these options can change the current IPv4 address for I(hostname).

options.name: ipv6_configuration
options.description: IPv6 network configuration. I(Warning) Ensure that you have an alternate interface to access OpenManage Enterprise as these options can change the current IPv6 address for I(hostname).

options.name: management_vlan
options.description: vLAN configuration. These settings are applicable for OpenManage Enterprise Modular.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular HTTPS port.

options.name: reboot_delay
options.description: The time in seconds, after which settings are applied. This option is not mandatory.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
